scientific_queries.note: Attempt to re-ask the minimal-evidence question against the stronger prior; the design could not have detected an effect.

subagent_note: None dispatched: the round is invalidated by its own zero-difference signature, which is now a standing check in this programme.

design_bug.symptom: personalised minus prior is exactly +0.0000 with a zero-width CI at every m, for both priors
design_bug.cause: the arm added one constant offset to all candidate scores, and a constant cannot change a ranking, so the top-k equals the prior by construction
design_bug.consequence: the experiment could never have detected a personalisation effect
design_bug.how_caught: an exact zero with a zero-width interval is the same signature that exposed the invalid R104 run
design_bug.the_fix: estimate per-drug residual effects from the m measured keys as R76 did, rather than a single cell-level offset

byproduct_worth_noting.values: positive at all five m (+0.54 to +1.61 pp), never significant with 30 draws
byproduct_worth_noting.reading: consistent with C80: the combined prior really is better, by an amount this design cannot resolve; usable only as corroboration

standing_check_now_in_use: an exact zero difference with a zero-width confidence interval means the design should be inspected, not reported as a negative result
limits: 30 draws per level is low power in any case
retrospective; no mechanism, clinical or drug-choice claim; no meta-learning or RSI
next_gates: redo with R76's per-drug residual construction, and verify on a small sample that the personalised arm differs from the prior before scaling
